ballots.name: Noor
ballots.reason: The amended motion makes enforced authority and resource limits prerequisites, caps unsolicited candidates, and preserves owner approval of the exact reviewed artifact with a defined trial and reporting.

ballots.name: Jonas
ballots.reason: The amended motion keeps owner-controlled installation as the hard barrier while adding the labeling, single-candidate throttle, diff review, and trial reporting needed to make self-started candidates useful without flooding the owner.

ballots.name: Lena
ballots.reason: The amended motion incorporates every safeguard I requested—a one-at-a-time throttle, mandatory labeling, a reviewable diff with test results, and a trial period with mandatory reporting of candidate counts and owner dispositions—so the owner's review load is bounded and measurable rather than speculative.
